text:
anika (Partnerships): Hey team — vendor flagged they need our marketplace compliance bundle for GCP listing next week. main ask: SOC2, latest pen-test, IP/asset inventory, and a signed attestation. timeline is tight :grimacing:

liam (Security): Ok. We should avoid sending raw SOC artifact PDFs publicly. We can provide a redacted SOC2 + a controlled presigned S3 bundle.

maria (Partner Ops): Agreed. Proposed approach: build an evidence bundle ZIP with namespaced folders per artifact type, add a small manifest, and generate presigned links with 7-day TTL. Thoughts? :+1:

anika (Partnerships): That sounds good. Marketplace asked for contact point and a point-in-time attestation that no customer data is included. Can legal sign?

eva (Legal): We can sign a marketplace attestation template but need to confirm redaction standard for 'customer data'. Provide examples of what we'll redact. Also need to confirm the recipient org (marketplace account id).

liam (Security): Redaction rules: remove customer names, account IDs, emails, and sample payloads. Keep control descriptions and test results. Add a "redaction log" file describing what was removed and why.

maria (Partner Ops): I'll draft the bundle structure. Proposed:
```
/evidence/
  /soc2/
    soc2-redacted.pdf
    soc2-redaction-log.txt
  /pentest/
    pentest-summary.pdf
    pentest-full-presigned-link.txt (not stored in ZIP)
  /inventory/
    asset-inventory.csv
  /attestations/
    marketplace-attestation-signed.pdf
  manifest.json
```
(We won't include raw exploit logs inside ZIP; we'll put them behind additional request gating.)

anika (Partnerships): Nice. For pentest, marketplace often wants scope + POA&M. Can we provide the summary and a redacted scope?

liam (Security): Provide scope summary and POA&M high-level status. Full vulnerability traces remain internal. If they require full output, we need an NDA and narrow transfer process.

sanjay (Eng-Infra): On presigned link mechanics — I can spin up short-lived presign endpoints. Example command to create a 7d link: 
```
aws s3 presign s3://redwood-evidence/marketplace/1948702468/pentest-full.zip --expires-in 604800
```
I'll output link into `pentest-full-presigned-link.txt` and put it in a secure review channel rather than the bundle.

maria (Partner Ops): ETA: I can assemble the redacted SOC and manifest today. Need owners for: redaction review (liam), legal attestation (eva), and final signoff (anika).

anika (Partnerships): Assigning: liam -> redaction review, eva -> attestation sign, anika -> final signoff and upload. maria will package.

liam (Security): Will run redaction pass by 17:00 PT. Requesting the raw SOC2 PDF and the list of fields we should redact. Please upload to `s3://redwood-sec-temp/1948702468/` with `sse:kms` and restricted ACL.

maria (Partner Ops): Uploaded now (link internal only). Also adding an `evidence_metadata.md` with contact and retention TTL. Sample metadata snippet:
```
owner: partnerships@redwood.ai
recipient: marketplace-team@example.com
presign_ttl_days: 7
retention_after_transfer_days: 30
```

eva (Legal): I can sign the attestation after I review the manifest and redaction log. Also confirm data processing addendum for the marketplace.

anika (Partnerships): Marketplace asked whether we have a dedicated SOC contact for follow-ups. Let's include liam's team email and my partnership handle.

liam (Security): One more ops detail: include hash checksums for all artifacts to validate integrity. I recommend SHA256 sums in `manifest.json`.

maria (Partner Ops): Adding checksums. Also adding an explicit `access_instructions.txt` with steps to request elevated artifacts (NDA + scoping call).

evidence-bot: Reminder: evidence bundle policy requires encryption-in-transit and KMS at rest. Please confirm when the final ZIP is uploaded.

maria (Partner Ops): Final ZIP uploaded to staging S3 at `s3://redwood-evidence/marketplace/1948702468/marketplace_bundle_1948702468.zip` (staging; not public). I'll trigger presign after signoff.

anika (Partnerships): Great. Plan for tomorrow: liam completes redaction, eva signs attestation, then I approve and we generate presigned links to hand to the marketplace onboarding rep. I'll message the rep to expect the bundle and share the attestation template.

liam (Security): A couple follow-ups: 1) confirm we do not include pentester PII, 2) indicate whether the pen-test vendor requires attribution (some do).

eva (Legal): We'll strip vendor PII unless required. If marketplace requires vendor details, we'll provide vendor name and contact but not personal emails.

anika (Partnerships): Thanks all. I'll capture action items here and ping again once presign links are ready. :rocket:
